controls.name: Info
controls.tooltip:
Displays and modifies object properties.

An object's properties are displayed in a dialog, where they can be modified.

controls.name: Show
controls.tooltip:
Highlights objects.

Highlight complete signals and nets with the Show command. Select parts in Design Manager or enter names on the command line in format @ (example: @ FB2 FB4). If a bus is selected, all nets belonging to that bus are also highlighted.

controls.name: Grid Settings
controls.tooltip:
Provides controls for defining the drawing grid.

Set grid display on/off, display style, and size.

controls.name: Mark Local Origin
controls.tooltip:
Defines a mark on the drawing area.

The X and Y coordinates of the mouse cursor relative to that point are displayed above the canvas, with an R prefix, polar coordinates with P prefix. This command is useful when defining locations of components or cutouts. Enter MARK; to turn the mark off.

controls.name: Select
controls.tooltip:
Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.

Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.

children.name: Ignore Violators
children.tooltip: Ignores design rules, allowing different copper objects to connect.

children.name: Push Violators
children.tooltip: Moves existing copper objects to make way for new copper objects while maintaining connectivity.

children.name: Walkaround Violators
children.tooltip: Moves new copper objects around existing copper objects and components while following Design Rules.

children.name: Push Vias
children.tooltip: Moves vias to accommodate new copper objects.

controls.name: Finish
controls.tooltip:
Saves the design file containing the machine model and closes the Machine Builder contextual environment.

If the machine is selected in a setup, its machine model is displayed in the canvas during machine simulation.

controls.name: Cancel
controls.tooltip: Discards any unsaved changes and closes with Machine Builder contextual environment without saving the design file.

controls.name: Finish
controls.tooltip:
Saves the design file containing the machine model and closes the Machine Builder contextual environment.

If the machine is selected in a setup, its machine model is displayed in the canvas during machine simulation.

children.name: New...
children.tooltip: Create a new Part, Assembly, Hybrid, or Electronics Design, a Drawing for the active design, or an Electronics Library.

children.name: Add To Assembly
children.tooltip:
Inserts the active design into an Assembly Design as an external component.

Select an Assembly Design to insert into, then use the manipulators in the canvas or Initial Position dialog to place the component in the target design.

children.name: From Design
children.tooltip:
Creates a drawing of the electronics design.

Place a view of the PCB. Place a diagram and table for the PCB Layer Stack.

children.name: Open...
children.tooltip:
Opens a design or drawing from your projects or local computer.

Select a design or drawing from the project browser and click Open, or click “Open from my computer” and select a supported file.

children.name: Open Recovered Documents (0)
children.tooltip:
Opens the Document Recovery dialog and displays a list of recovery documents.

Recovery documents are cached locally. Use them to recover design data if Fusion closes unexpectedly.

In Preferences, set the Automatic Backup Interval to control how frequently data is backed up.

children.name: Save
children.tooltip:
Saves a design to a selected location within a project.

Save your design frequently to prevent loss of work in the event of a power failure or unexpected crash.

children.name: Advance to Latest
children.tooltip: Advances all components in the assembly with their latest changes, even if those changes are not versions.

children.name: Create Version
children.tooltip:
Marks the current state of the design as a significant iteration.

By default, the latest version of your design is the one referenced by other designs. Changes don't appear in external references until you create a new version of your design.

children.name: 3D Print
children.tooltip:
Prepares solid or mesh bodies to be 3D printed directly from Fusion's Manufacture workspace or from an external application.

Select solid or mesh bodies to prepare, then select a Preparation Type to switch to the Manufacture workspace, export and send to an installed 3D printing application, or export a 3MF, STL, or OBJ file. For exports, adjust the output and refinement settings to control the resolution of the mesh.

children.name: Capture Image...
children.tooltip:
Captures the current canvas as an image.

Set the image size and resolution then set the file type (*.png, *.jpg, *.tiff) and file name.

children.name: Share File Link
children.tooltip:
Creates a shareable link so that viewers can download the design, view it online, or share it with others.

You can protect the link with a password; the design can be viewed in the cloud even without Fusion installed.
